goal: Bring the Astrology area to the approved AstroHub, AstroBirth and AstroChart designs: a hub with the user Big 3 summary, a Moon-in-house Today block, a moon calendar tile, the 12 signs entry with progress and saved charts; a day/month/year birth form; and a chart screen with role-labelled Big 3, a free template summary plus an AI deep-read block, topic tabs and a collapsible wheel and data section. Content that is not yet approved stays hidden.
successCriteria: Hub (home stage) shows the user chart Big 3 with a one-line template summary when a chart is saved, a Today block when the Moon-house content is approved, a moon tile with days to the next full or new moon, 12 cung & thần thoại with chapters read, and saved charts.
Birth form uses day / month / year fields, keeps the exact / approximate / unknown time modes with AM/PM for exact times, keeps the offline place search, and still computes the chart on the device.

Chart screen shows name/date/time/place, the template headline and summary, Big 3 cards with roles, an Đọc sâu với AI block (free: what AI adds and Có trong Premium leading to Sắp ra mắt; premium: write button with remaining count; hidden until the server change is deployed), Tổng quan plus topic tabs once their content is approved, and a collapsible wheel and data section.
Synastry (So với một người) is built in a later task of this slice after its content is approved.
npm --workspace apps/mobile run check and the mobile Jest suite pass, and a 390x844 web walkthrough covers hub, form and chart.
untouchedSurfaces: Edge Functions, prompts, entitlements and database are unchanged in this task; the server change for Astrology AI is a separate Owner-approved deploy.
Astrology content data in packages/content stays unchanged until the Owner approves the drafts.
Tarot, Home, Journal and Chat screens.
